title: cog: a STAC Item whose data is a Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF
description: A STAC Item whose data asset is a Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF that the map reads in the browser (from build week 2). The data asset carries its bands with whole-raster statistics, written at publish, so the legend and the colour domain need no server. Written by the atlas pipeline, workflows/R/eov_share.R and erddap-places Then vs Now; read by the atlas and @oceanmetrics/map. STAC core is out of scope: only type, stac_version, id and the profile's own fields are constrained, and other keys pass through.

properties.description: the item properties; proj:code is required

proj:code.description: the CRS of the COG as an EPSG code (projection extension 2.0). Today every COG is EPSG:4326; web-optimised EPSG:3857 copies are a build week 2 decision, so any EPSG code passes.

assets.description: the assets; at least one has roles including data and the COG media type, and that asset lists its bands with statistics

isDataCog.description: an asset with roles including data and type image/tiff; application=geotiff; profile=cloud-optimized

asset.description: a STAC asset; the atlas draw hints are typed on any asset, the bands on a data COG

atlas:bidx.description: the 1-based band to draw; absent = band 1

atlas:rescale.description: the display range [min, max], or auto (read from the band statistics)

atlas:colormap.description: a named colormap (viridis, spectral_r ...); absent = the default ramp

then.description: a data COG lists its bands as bands (STAC 1.1 core, raster 2.0 fields inside) or raster:bands (raster 1.1)

bands.description: one entry per band of the COG, in band order

band.description: a band: its data type, nodata and whole-raster statistics (written at publish so the legend needs no server). Other band keys (raster:scale, raster:offset ...) pass through.

data_type.description: the pixel data type (raster extension values)

nodata.description: the nodata value: a number, nan, inf or -inf, or null when the band has none

statistics.description: the whole-raster statistics of the band's valid pixels; minimum and maximum are required

mean.description: the mean of the valid values

stddev.description: the standard deviation of the valid values

valid_percent.description: the share of valid (not nodata) pixels, 0 to 100

histogram.description: the distribution of the valid values: count equal-width buckets from min to max

min.description: the lower edge of the first bucket

max.description: the upper edge of the last bucket
